## Summary

Burak Şafak is a senior mobile application developer and computer engineer based in Ankara, Turkey. He has more than five years of professional experience. He started coding at age 15 during high school and began his professional career in 2021. He currently works at Ray Sigorta as a Senior Software Development Specialist.

His core expertise is Flutter mobile development, plus web and .NET Core backend work. On mobile, the focus is Flutter and Dart.

He aims to ship solutions that are not only working but also structured, performant, secure, and aligned with engineering discipline.

## Work

- Ray Sigorta — Senior Software Development Specialist / Senior Mobile Developer (July 2025 – present). Development and architecture updates for the Ray eXpress Acente and Ray Connect mobile apps. Converting WebView screens such as DASK and contracted auto services into native Flutter screens. Modernizing iOS notification infrastructure with APNs (.p8) and Firebase.
- MİA Teknoloji — Mobile Application Developer (past). Modular Flutter mobile apps for health informatics and public/hospital software.
- AR AiTech — Mobile Application Developer (past). Mobile app development and backend API integration.
